sections.title: API Overview
sections.raw_content:
- **Base URL**: `http://localhost:8000/api/v1`
- **Content-Type**: `application/json`
- **Version**: v1 (all endpoints under `/api/v1/`)
- **Authentication**: JWT Bearer tokens in `Authorization: Bearer <token>` header

---

sections.title: Response Envelope
sections.raw_content: All responses follow a consistent envelope shape per constitution...

sections.title: POST `/api/v1/auth/register`
sections.raw_content:
**Role**: Student (self-registration)

**Request**:

```json
{
  "email": "student@example.com",
  "password": "securepassword123",
  "display_name": "Alice Student"
}
```

**Response** (201 Created):

```json
{
  "data": {
    "user": {
      "id": "uuid",
      "email": "student@example.com",
      "display_name": "Alice Student",
      "role": "student",
      "created_at": "2026-06-27T12:00:00Z"
    },
    "tokens": {
      "access_token": "eyJhbGc...",
      "refresh_token": "eyJhbGc...",
      "token_type": "bearer",
      "expires_in": 900
    }
  },
  "meta": {...},
  "errors": []
}
```

**Side Effects**:
- Welcome email sent via Resend (async BackgroundTask) with student's name and link to browse courses
- Email does NOT block response

**Errors**:
- `400 Bad Request`: Email invalid or already registered
- `400 Bad Request`: Password too weak
- `400 Bad Request`: Display name missing

---

sections.title: DELETE `/api/v1/courses/{course_id}`
sections.raw_content:
**Role**: Instructor-only (owner only)

**Authorization Header**: `Authorization: Bearer <access_token>`

**Business Rule**: "ActiveEnrollmentConstraint"
- If the course has active enrollments, deletion is rejected with 409 Conflict
- If no enrollments exist, course and its modules are deleted

**Response** (204 No Content) — if successful

**Error Response** (409 Conflict) — if active enrollments exist:

```json
{
  "data": null,
  "meta": {...},
  "errors": [
    {
      "code": "ACTIVE_ENROLLMENT_CONSTRAINT",
      "message": "Cannot delete course with active enrollments",
      "business_rule": "ActiveEnrollmentConstraint"
    }
  ]
}
```

**Errors**:
- `401 Unauthorized`: Missing or invalid token
- `403 Forbidden`: Not the course owner
- `404 Not Found`: Course not found
- `409 Conflict`: Course has active enrollments

---

sections.title: PUT `/api/v1/enrollments/{enrollment_id}`
sections.raw_content:
**Role**: Student-only (owner only)

**Authorization Header**: `Authorization: Bearer <access_token>`

**Request**:

```json
{
  "progress": 75,
  "completed_at": null
}
```

**Response** (200 OK):

```json
{
  "data": {
    "id": "enrollment-uuid",
    "student_id": "user-uuid",
    "course_id": "course-uuid",
    "progress": 75,
    "completed_at": null,
    "created_at": "2026-06-27T12:00:00Z",
    "updated_at": "2026-06-27T12:45:00Z"
  },
  "meta": {...},
  "errors": []
}
```

**Auto-completion**:
- If `progress == 100` and `completed_at == null`, the system automatically sets `completed_at` to the current timestamp

**Example of auto-completion**:

```json
{
  "progress": 100,
  "completed_at": null
}
```

**Response**:

```json
{
  "data": {
    "id": "enrollment-uuid",
    "student_id": "user-uuid",
    "course_id": "course-uuid",
    "progress": 100,
    "completed_at": "2026-06-27T12:46:00Z",
    "created_at": "2026-06-27T12:00:00Z",
    "updated_at": "2026-06-27T12:46:00Z"
  },
  "meta": {...},
  "errors": []
}
```

**Validation**:
- Progress must be 0–100 (inclusive)

**Errors**:
- `401 Unauthorized`: Missing or invalid token
- `403 Forbidden`: Enrollment belongs to another student
- `404 Not Found`: Enrollment not found
- `400 Bad Request`: Progress outside 0–100 range

sections.title: Full Workflow: Register → Create Course → Enroll → Progress

elements.content: Authentication via JWT Bearer tokens in Authorization header
All responses follow a consistent envelope shape with data, meta, and errors fields
Student self-registration allowing creation of user and issuance of JWT tokens
Public login for students and instructors returning JWT tokens
Refresh access token using a valid refresh token
Instructor-only creation of courses including modules
Instructor-only retrieval of their own courses with pagination
Public access to published courses; instructor access to their own courses
Instructor-only update of their own courses
ActiveEnrollmentConstraint: Course cannot be deleted if it has active enrollments
Student enrollment in a published course; prevents duplicate enrollments
If progress is 100 and completed_at is null, system automatically sets completed_at
User entity: id, email, display_name, role, created_at, hashed_password
Course entity: id, instructor_id, title, description, price_cents, published, timestamps, modules
Module entity: id, course_id, title, order, created_at
Enrollment entity: id, student_id, course_id, progress, completed_at, timestamps
